titre: Les encours des comptes gérés aux États Unis
sous_titre: Encours total du secteur, en milliers de Mds $, par trimestre

series.nom: Encours des comptes gérés aux États Unis

T1 2025.texte: managed account assets declined 0.2% for the quarter, falling to $13.7 trillion

T2 2025.texte: managed account assets rebounded in Q2, growing 7.7% to reach $14.8 trillion

T3 2025.texte: Managed account assets continued their strong growth from Q2, increasing 6.9% to reach $15.8 trillion in Q3 2025.

T4 2025.texte: Total managed account industry assets grew 3.2% quarterly, to reach $16.3 trillion in Q4 2025.

T1 2026.texte: The managed accounts industry recorded its first quarter-over-quarter asset decline since Q3 2023, down 0.2% to $16.4 trillion in Q1 2026.
